caption: The video captures a tabletop apparatus: a clear acrylic stand with two angled support posts holds a vertically mounted spiral coil of concentric rings on a central pivot. It rests on a white plate atop a green mat and wooden board, set against a black backdrop with a gray wall at right. A bright blue rod fixed at the pivot spins continuously, appearing in each frame as a blurred radial streak that points successively left, upward, rightward, and downward, cycling around the center. A white curved arc sweeps around the coil in step with the streak. The coil, posts, base, and background remain fixed while the camera stays still. At the left edge a person's light-colored sleeve and blurred hand appear; the hand moves in and out of view during the early frames, after which only the sleeve remains. The rotation is already underway at the first frame and continues through the last, neither starting nor stopping within the clip.
